prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity portrait iPhone app Home screen for Forkware, edge-to-edge screen only, no device frame or external background. Reference screenshot supplies ONLY existing palette, Barlow Condensed display font, SF body type, native iOS chrome and tonal component character; do not copy its Plan content or large panel verbatim. Warm ivory #F7F3EA canvas, charcoal #191918 text, peach #F3AD88 primary fill with charcoal labels, deep peach #984C31 links. Crisp native controls, generous 44pt targets, no photos, illustrations, gradients or ornamental icons. Top iOS status area, header Home with small Forkware context and gear Settings icon top right. Bottom native five-tab bar exactly Home, Plan, Recipes, Shop, Assistant; Home selected. Fit actual screen at roughly 402x874 logical points, output portrait aspect ~0.46. Text should be legible and restrained, strong hierarchy, no huge empty header space. Upcoming meals must lead. Sample data is illustrative for the concept. No pantry inventory, expiry or stock claims. Render enough of the screen to show recipe discovery and shopping. Composition B, TONIGHT & BEYOND: Native Home header then dominant charcoal tonight panel at top, about 240 logical points tall. Small 'Tonight · Tuesday', condensed recipe title 'Garlic-herb chicken', smaller 'Dinner for two', broad peach 'Start cooking' native button. Immediately below outside panel one compact upcoming row 'Tomorrow' / 'Beef tacos' and trailing 'View plan'. Next shopping progress as slim flat full-width row: basket icon, '8 items left', subline 'Shopping · next 2 weeks', chevron. Then 'What sounds good next?' heading, paired stacked native text actions 'Browse recipes' and 'Create with Assistant', each with simple SF symbol and chevron. Preserve ample spacing and make discovery fully visible before the tab bar. This is the cooking-forward option; one confident focal panel, supporting sections calm.
